verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email as a distinct message type for receipts, password resets and account notices, alongside broadcasts and sequences, and it can be sent via the CLI. Nothing in the evidence shows transactional mail bypassing marketing unsubscribes, using separate suppression rules, or sending on an isolated reputation or IP stream. Missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends reach unsubscribed contacts, separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation/IP pool, transactional-specific templates, independent corroboration.
